doc.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: First major gig with Mongo Santamaria
summary: Right after arriving in New York, Corea spends a year and a half with Mongo through tenor player Al Abreu.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: ...in your own bands and in other situations. Speaking of that, not long after you got to New York (I’m not sure how long it was), you were playing with Mongo Santamaria.

It was my first major gig with Mongo. It must have been 1960, late ‘60, something like that. Yeah, I got the gig with Mongo. Somehow, my friend, Al Abreu, who was the tenor player in the band at the time, he knew that I liked Latin music, and I spent a year-and-a-half playing with Mongo.
So really right after you got to New York.
Really right after I got here, yeah.
